body: 怀着沉痛的心情，我谨对朱镕基总理的逝世致以哀悼。他的贡献难以枚举，留下的非凡遗产，对当代及后世具有深远意义。It is with great sadness that I share my condolences on the passing of Premier Zhu Rongji, whose contributions are too numerous to count. He leaves behind an extraordinary legacy of impact, one that will continue to have profound meaning for this and future generations.
